entries.en: What is it? Can I help you?

entries.speaker: Late Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: You again? You'll be late for school,[n]you know.
Good morning.
Which way is the train station?

entries.speaker: Late Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: Ah, you must be that boy who's living[n]with Boss now. I was wondering who[n]you were.

entries.speaker: Late Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: You're a high school student, aren't you?[n]You can't loiter if you want to make it to[n]school.

entries.speaker: Late Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: Go back out this alley, and turn[n]left at the intersection. From there,[n]you'll see the big main road.

entries.speaker: Late Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: Well, you could also keep going[n]straight through here. It can[n]get a bit narrow though.

entries.speaker: Late Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: Don't make me explain it to you[n]so many times.

entries.speaker: Late Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: Go back, and turn left at the intersection.[n]Or, you can go straight down this path.

entries.speaker: Late Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: You should hurry on. I hear the trains[n]are running late because of the accident[n]yesterday.

entries.speaker: Late Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: It was terrible, just terrible.[n]Just what is going on with the world?

entries.speaker: Kindly Officer
entries.en: Hm? Is something the matter?

entries.speaker: Kindly Officer
entries.en: ...Hm? Did you forget something?
Is something happening?
How do I get to the train station?

entries.speaker: Kindly Officer
entries.en: Oh, don't worry, it's not anything major.[n]It's just a patrol.

entries.speaker: Kindly Officer
entries.en: Patrols are a good idea after an accident[n]like that. A lot of residents have been[n]worried.

entries.speaker: Kindly Officer
entries.en: Did you get lost? Yongen-Jaya Station is[n]in the opposite direction.

entries.speaker: Kindly Officer
entries.en: You see the main road over there, right?[n]Get over there, and the station will be[n]nearby.

entries.speaker: Kindly Officer
entries.en: You best hurry if you want to take[n]the train. The schedules are a bit[n]off due to yesterday's accident.

entries.speaker: Kindly Officer
entries.en: Go toward the main road, at the opposite[n]end of here. If you don't hurry, you'll miss[n]your train.

entries.speaker: Kindly Officer
entries.en: Yeah, the accident yesterday was a real[n]catastrophe. It's tragic, what happened.
